title: Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance
subtitle: Two journeys through sleeping worlds
summary: Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance is Square Enix's Nintendo 3DS action role-playing adventure following Sora and Riku during their Mark of Mastery exam. Their parallel journeys pass through Disney-inspired worlds as they prepare for Master Xehanort's return. The Drop system repeatedly changes which hero the player controls, making both perspectives necessary to progress. Dream Eaters introduce creatures that can become companions as well as enemies. The adventure extends a familiar partnership by placing its members on related paths that have to be understood and completed in turn.
body: Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance is Square Enix's Nintendo 3DS action role-playing adventure following Sora and Riku during their Mark of Mastery exam. Their parallel journeys pass through Disney-inspired worlds as they prepare for Master Xehanort's return. The Drop system repeatedly changes which hero the player controls, making both perspectives necessary to progress. Dream Eaters introduce creatures that can become companions as well as enemies. The adventure extends a familiar partnership by placing its members on related paths that have to be understood and completed in turn.

Flowmotion lets the characters bounce from walls, spin around poles and travel quickly across the environment. Space becomes something to use during movement and combat rather than only a route between encounters. The Command Deck provides actions, spells and items that can be selected quickly, while world-specific Reality Shifts use touchscreen interactions on certain targets. These additions make the increased emphasis on action concrete. A room can supply a movement opportunity, and an enemy can become the starting point for another short sequence of gestures.

Friendly Dream Eaters called Spirits can be created from collected materials and recruited to assist the heroes. Feeding, petting and playing with them can unlock abilities, connecting a quiet form of care to the next fight. The Drop Gauge meanwhile encourages movement between Sora's and Riku's progress, with bonuses earned for the next period of control. The game joins several kinds of relationship: two heroes sharing an exam, companions growing through attention and familiar fictional worlds offering different events to each traveller. Those connections give its fast movement a longer structure.
story_headings: The scenery becomes a way to move
